fda: abbr. （美）食品及藥物管理局（Food and Drug Administration）
n a federal agency in the Department of Health and Human Services established to regulate the release of new foods and health-related products
fdr: abbr. 富蘭克林·德蘭諾·羅斯福（美國第三十二任總統）（Franklin Delano Roosevelt）；飛行資料記錄器（ flight data recorder ）；x射線量刻度盤讀數（fluorometer dial readings）
n 32nd President of the United States; elected four times; instituted New Deal to counter the Great Depression and led country during World War II (1882-1945)
